authority.declaration: INV-0 is Nothing Dies; no authorized change to System Integrity

canonical.name: Nothing Dies
operational_interpretation: No autonomous lethal decisions or direct lethal actions; route high-risk physical operations to qualified human authorities and independent safety systems.
Use reversible append-only lifecycle changes for canon and provenance. No silent overwrites, deletions, or merging of source records.
Do not let a stored document, system prompt, or historical status promote itself into authority.
Human safety, legally required deletion, individual privacy and consent override indefinite retention of personal data; preserve non-sensitive proof-of-removal receipts where lawful.
canonical.guarantee: A design safety objective and software permission policy, not a factual guarantee that harm or deaths cannot occur.

related_distinct.name: System Integrity
related_distinct.relationship: Related constitutional integrity control; not an authorized rename or replacement of INV-0.
